description: Consolidated Size / Index / NonZero axioms and checked_add/sub/mul atoms. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/core — verified primitives'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/prelude.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/prelude.mm already uses (basic comparisons, conditional expressions, arithmetic).

atoms.name: checked_add
atoms.description: Bounded addition for non-negative i64 values. Proves the result fits in i64 by constraining each operand to <= max_val/2 so the sum cannot overflow.

atoms.name: checked_sub
atoms.description: Subtraction with the precondition that the minuend is at least as large as the subtrahend, so the result is always non-negative.

atoms.name: checked_mul
atoms.description: Bounded multiplication for non-negative i64 values. Each operand is constrained to a square-root-like bound so the product fits in i64.

atoms.name: safe_narrow
atoms.description: Narrow an i64 to a non-negative i64 by asserting the precondition v >= 0. Used by callers that need a typed `Nat`-like value without changing the storage representation.
